name: agent-security-hardening
title: agent-security-hardening
description: Defensive hardening workflow for agent runtimes that ingest untrusted content and turn model output into tool, file and network actions: trust-boundary mapping, fail-closed rules, per-capability write grants.
why: The security shelf was almost entirely offensive (the BugHunter hunts) or API-generic; this is the missing defensive counterpart, and its threat model is exactly the owner's Telegram bots — untrusted messages in, actions out.
